sanskrit: baṭ sūrya śravasā mahāṃ asi satrā deva mahāṃ asi . mahnā devānāmasuryaḥ purohito vibhu jyotiradābhyam śikṣeyamasmai ditseyaṃ śacīpate manīṣiṇe . yadahaṃ gopatiḥ syām bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhiryajatrāḥ . sthirairaṅgaistuṣṭuvāṃ sastanūbhirvyaśemahi devahitaṃ yadāyuḥ
english: Verily, O Sun, thou art great in fame; truly, O God, thou art great. By greatness thou art the lord of the gods, the sovereign chaplain, all-pervading light, undeceivable. May I impart instruction to this wise devotee, O Lord of power, and bestow gifts upon him. When I shall be lord of cattle, may we hear blessed things with our ears, O Gods; may we see blessed things with our eyes, O ye worthy of worship. With firm limbs and bodies that have been praised, may we attain the full span of life appointed by the gods.

sanskrit: dhenuṣṭa indra sūnṛtā yajamānāya sunvate . gāmaśvaṃ pipyuṣī duhe svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ . svasti nastārkṣyo ariṣṭanemiḥ svasti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu .. Oṃ svasti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu
english: O Indra, thy cow of truth milks out the cow and horse, swelling with abundance, for the sacrificer who presses the soma. May Indra of mighty fame grant us welfare; may Pūṣan who knows all grant us welfare. May Tārkṣya of unbroken wheel grant us welfare; may Bṛhaspati grant us welfare. Oṃ — may Bṛhaspati grant us welfare.

sanskrit: upa no haribhiḥ sutam mahe raṇāya cakṣase
english: Come to our pressed soma with thy bay steeds, for the great battle-joy and for sight.

sanskrit: dvitā yo vṛtrahantamo vida indraḥ śatakratuḥ . upa no haribhiḥ sutam yo vaḥ śivatamo rasastasya bhājayateha naḥ . uśatīriva mātaraḥ
english: Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, of hundredfold wisdom, who knows both worlds — come to our pressed soma with thy bay steeds. That which is the most benign juice among you, let it refresh us here, as eager mothers.

sanskrit: tvaṃ hi vṛtrahanneṣāṃ pātā somānāmasi . upa no haribhiḥ sutam tasmā araṃ gamāma vo yasya kṣayāya jinvatha . āpo janayathā ca naḥ
english: For thou, O Vṛtra-slayer, art the drinker of these soma juices. Come to our pressed soma with thy bay steeds. To him we go who stirs you to fullness for his dwelling, and ye waters also bring us forth.

sanskrit: viśaḥ pūrvīḥ pra cara carṣaṇiprāḥ pra na ayūṃṣi tāriṣat
english: Move forth among the many peoples, O thou who fillest mankind; may he extend our life-spans.

sanskrit: uruvyacase mahine suvṛktimindrāya brahma janayanta viprāḥ . tasya vratāni na minanti dhīrāḥ uta vāta pitāsi na uta bhrātota naḥ sakhā . sa no jīvātave kṛdhi
english: The inspired singers have fashioned a hymn of good praise for great Indra of wide renown. The wise do not transgress his ordinances. And thou, O Wind, art our father, our brother, and also our friend. Do thou make us to live.

sanskrit: indraṃ vāṇīranuttamanyumeva satrā rājānaṃ dadhire sahadhyai . haryaśvāya barhayā samāpīn yadado vāta te gṛhe3 'mṛtaṃ nihitaṃ guhā . tasyo no dehi jīvase
english: The voices have established Indra, whose wrath none can check, as the true universal king for companionship. For him of the bay steeds lay down the sacred grass together with the pressings. That amrita hidden in thy secret house, O Wind — of that give us to live.

sanskrit: stotāramiddadhiṣe radāvaso na pāpatvāya raṃsiṣam sūryasya bhānumṛtuthā vasānaḥ pari svayaṃ medhamṛjro jajāna
english: Thou holdest only the praiser, O wealth-giver; may I never rest in wickedness. Clothing himself seasonally in the rays of the sun, the bright one has by himself generated the sacrifice all around.

sanskrit: śikṣeyaminmahayate divedive rāya ā kuhacidvide . na hi tvadanyanmaghavanna āpyaṃ vasyo asti pitā ca na apsu retaḥ śiśriye viśvarūpaṃ tejaḥ pṛthivyāmadhi yatsambabhūva . antarikṣe svaṃ mahimānaṃ mimānaḥ kanikranti vṛṣṇo aśvasya retaḥ
english: May I truly bestow glory upon him who magnifies day by day, wherever wealth may be found. For, O Maghavan, there is nothing better for us than thee, and no father. The seed was deposited in the waters; the all-formed lustre that arose on the earth, measuring out its own greatness in the mid-air — that is the shining seed of the rain-giving bull.

sanskrit: ayaṃ sahasrā pari yuktā vasānaḥ sūryasya bhānuṃ yajño dādhāra . sahasradāḥ śatadā bhūridāvā dharttā divo bhuvanasya viśpatiḥ
english: This sacrifice, wearing around it thousands of garlands, has sustained the ray of the sun. Giving a thousandfold, a hundredfold, bestowing abundantly — he is the upholder of heaven, the lord of the world.

sanskrit: kṛṣvā duvāṃsyantamā sacemā hiraṇyapakṣaṃ varuṇasya dūtaṃ yamasya yonau śakunaṃ bhuraṇyum
english: Do the services; let us accompany him to the end — the golden-winged bird, Varuṇa's messenger, the agile one in Yama's womb.

sanskrit: na te giro api mṛṣye turasya na suṣṭutimasuryasya vidvān . sadā te nāma svayaśo vivakmi ūrdhvo gandharvo adhi nāke asthātpratyañcitrā bibhradasyāyudhāni . vasāno atkaṃ surabhiṃ dṛśe kaṃ sva3rṇa nāma janata priyāṇi
english: I do not disregard thy songs, O swift one; knowing thy excellent praise as the lord, I always proclaim thy self-glorious name. The Gandharva stood upright in the sky bearing his shining weapons gleaming toward us, wearing a fragrant robe to behold — they have fashioned the dear things in the name of the sun.

sanskrit: bhūri hi te savanā mānuṣeṣu bhūri manīṣī havate tvāmit . māre asmanmaghavañjyokkaḥ drapsaḥ samudramabhi yajjigāti paśyangṛdhrasya cakṣasā vidharman . bhānuḥ śukreṇa śociṣā cakānastṛtīye cakre rajasi priyāṇi
english: Many are thy soma pressings among men; many a wise man calls upon thee. Be not far from us long, O Maghavan. The drop that moves toward the ocean, looking with the eye of the eagle beyond the order of things — the ray, delighting in its bright flame, has set the beloved things in motion in the third region.

sanskrit: abhīke cidu lokakṛtsaṅge samatsu vṛtraha . asmākaṃ bodhi coditā nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu
english: Even in the clashes, in the battle-joinings, in the encounters, O Vṛtra-slayer, be thou the instigator of our side. May the bowstrings of the others snap upon their bows.

sanskrit: tvaṃ sindhūṃravāsṛjo 'dharāco ahannahim . aśatrurindra jajñiṣe viśvaṃ puṣyasi vāryam . taṃ tvā pari ṣvajāmahe nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu
english: Thou didst release the rivers downward and didst slay the serpent. Thou wast born without a foe, O Indra; thou nourishest all that is desirable. Thee we embrace on all sides. May the bowstrings of the others snap upon their bows.

sanskrit: vi ṣu viśvā arātayo 'ryo naśanta no dhiyaḥ . astāsi śatrave vadhaṃ yo na indra jighāṃsati . yā te rātirdadivasu nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu
english: Let all the enemies and the niggards of the noble one perish from our thoughts. Thou art the hurler of the weapon against the enemy who desires to destroy us, O Indra. Thy gift, O giver of wealth — may the bowstrings of the others snap upon their bows.

sanskrit: predu harivaḥ sutasya
english: Go forward, O thou of the bay horses, to the pressed soma.

sanskrit: ukthaṃ ca na śasyamānaṃ nāgo rayirā ciketa . na gāyatraṃ gīyamānam
english: Neither the uktha being recited, nor wealth, nor the serpent takes note; nor the gayatra being sung.

sanskrit: mā na indra pīyatnave mā śardhate parā dāḥ . śikṣā śacīvaḥ śacībhiḥ
english: Do not give us over, O Indra, to the scorner; do not give us to the insolent. Aid us, O powerful one, with thy powers.

sanskrit: divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso
english: Of that commanding heaven, go to heaven, O thou who hast the sky as thy dwelling.

sanskrit: atrā vi nemireṣāmurāṃ na dhūnute vṛkaḥ . divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso
english: Here the wolf shakes not these wide spaces, as a wheel shakes. Of that commanding heaven, go to heaven, O thou who hast the sky as thy dwelling.

sanskrit: ā tvā grāvā vadanīha somī ghoṣeṇa vakṣatu . divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso
english: May the speaking soma-pressing stone carry thee hither with its sound. Of that commanding heaven, go to heaven, O thou who hast the sky as thy dwelling.

sanskrit: te sutāso vipaścitaḥ śukrā vāyumasṛkṣata
english: These bright, insightful soma pressings have been sent forth to Vāyu.

sanskrit: asṛgraṃ devavītaye vājayanto rathā iva
english: They have been released for the feast of the gods, seeking prizes like chariots.

sanskrit: ya ūrdhvaro svadhvaro devo devācyā kṛpā . ghṛtasya vibhrāṣṭimanu śukraśociṣa ājuhvānasya sarpiṣaḥ
english: He who is the highest, the good sacrificer, the god by the grace of the gods — following the radiant flash of ghee, of the bright-flamed, the offering clarified butter is poured.

sanskrit: yajiṣṭhaṃ tvā yajamānā huvema jyeṣṭhamaṅgirasāṃ vipra manmabhirviprebhiḥ śukramanmabhiḥ . parijmānamiva dyāṃ hotāraṃ carṣaṇīnām . śociṣkeśaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ yamimā viśaḥ prāvantu jūtaye viśaḥ
english: O thou most worthy of worship, we sacrificers call upon thee, the eldest of the Aṅgiras-sages, O inspired one, with inspired thoughts and with bright thoughts — as the all-pervading hotar of peoples like the sky. The flame-haired, rain-giving one whom these peoples favor to speed them onward — let the peoples favor him for swiftness.

sanskrit: sa hi purū cidojasā virukmatā dīdyāno bhavati druhantaraḥ paraśurna druhantaraḥ . vīḍu cidyasya samṛtau śruvadvaneva yatsthiram . niṣṣahamāṇo yamate nāyate dhanvāsahā nāyate
english: For he shines brightly with many-radiant strength, being the better destroyer — like an axe, the better destroyer. That which is firm in his conflict, like a standing tree, being irresistible he goes; he is not led away — the bow-resistor, he is not led away.
